Faq.contactDesc: Can't find the answer you're after? Reach out to us directly.

Items.a1: Express Entry is the online system Canada uses to manage permanent-residence applications through three programs: Federal Skilled Worker, Canadian Experience Class, and Federal Skilled Trades. Candidates are ranked by CRS score; the top ones receive an Invitation to Apply (ITA).
Items.q2: How is my CRS score calculated?
Items.a2: The CRS (Comprehensive Ranking System) score is based on your age, language level (French and/or English), education, work experience and family situation. Use our free CRS calculator to estimate it.
Items.q3: How long does Express Entry take?
Items.a3: Once you receive an ITA you have 60 days to submit a complete file. IRCC processing typically takes 6 months. The overall timeline depends on your upfront prep — our Timeline helps you plan every step.
Items.a4: Yes! All our online tools (CRS calculator, ITA countdown, 67-point calculator, NOC lookup, Timeline) are 100% free, no sign-up. Personal support, document review and consultation are paid.
Items.q5: What is WES and do I need it?
Items.a5: WES (World Education Services) is an organisation that officially evaluates and recognises foreign credentials in Canada. It is generally required for Federal Skilled Worker. We help you through the process, including IQUAS for candidates in Cameroon.
Items.q6: How do I prepare for TCF Canada?
Items.a6: TCF Canada measures your French in listening, reading, speaking and writing. Each score maps to NCLC levels that feed directly into your CRS. Our TCF Express Academy platform gets you ready with mock exams and personalised coaching.
